title: How to Trade Perpetual Futures (Metals, Stocks) on Binance Wallet (Web): Binance Tutorial (2026)
description:
*Perps in your browser, self‑custody by default.* In this step‑by‑step tutorial, Orlando shows how to trade Perpetual Futures directly inside Binance Wallet (Web), powered by Aster on BNB Smart Chain.

Open long/short positions from your Keyless Wallet with MPC security (no seed phrase), use popular BSC tokens like BNB, ASTER, USDT, BTC, and ETH as collateral, and access both crypto perpetuals and stock perpetuals (e.g., Apple, Nvidia, ETFs like QQQ). You’ll also see how metal‑linked stock perpetuals track prices for XAU/XAG/XPT/XCU/XPD—derivative contracts that reflect metal prices (not physical metals)—and how every trade earns Aster Points for potential rewards.

*⚠️ You need to be verified with Binance before you can use Futures trading. ⚠️*
➡️ How to Complete KYC & Verify Your Binance Account: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yvtGCZ8ENEQ

*📚 Resources:*
➡️ Binance Wallet (Web): https://web3.binance.com/
➡️ About Binance Wallet (Web): https://web3.binance.com/en/about?chain=bsc

*In this video, you’ll learn:*
✅ What makes perps on Binance Wallet (Web) different: self‑custody Keyless Wallet with MPC security
✅ How to enable Aster Perpetuals on Binance Wallet (Web) and approve trading from your mobile app
✅ Funding your account: transferring collateral on‑chain (BNB, ASTER, USDT, BTC, ETH, and more)
✅ Placing and managing perpetual futures positions directly from your wallet
✅ Accessing stock perpetuals (Apple, Nvidia, QQQ) and metal‑linked contracts (XAU, XAG, XPT, XCU, XPD) as derivatives
✅ Earning Aster Points on every trade and finding special campaigns for Keyless Wallet users

*⏱️ Timestamps:*
⏳ 00:00 – Introduction: Perp Futures in Binance Wallet (Web), powered by Aster
⏳ 00:30 – Why Trade Futures on Binance Wallet (Web): self‑custody, MPC security, and UX benefits
⏳ 01:24 – TradFi meets Crypto: You can trade precious metals and commodities perp contracts as well!
⏳ 02:25 – Getting started: navigate to web3.binance.com and find 'Perpetuals'
⏳ 02:36 – Enable Account and approve trading via the Binance App
⏳ 02:51 – Transfer collateral on‑chain and confirm balances to start trading!
⏳ 03:13 – Aster Points and Reward Campaigns from Binance Wallet
⏳ 03:26 – Outro

💬 Got questions? Drop them in the comments—we’re here to help!
#Binance #futurestrading #xauusd #cryptofutures #binancewallet #BinanceGuide #BinanceTutorial

*⚠️ NOTE: Perpetual futures are complex instruments and carry a high risk of rapid losses due to leverage.* Not available in some jurisdictions. Metal‑linked contracts are derivatives that reflect underlying prices; you are not buying physical metals. This video is for educational purposes only and is not financial advice. Always trade responsibly.

asr.full_text: hey there i'm a leonard from binance and today i'm going to walk you through an exciting new feature in binary's wallet web trading perpetual futures powered by asta on the bnb smart chain this upgrade lets you trade perpetual futures directly from your keyless wallet putting you in complete control of your assets with a fast secure and seamless experience let's dive right in just the heads up this tutorial features the web version of Binance Wallet so please log on to web3.binance.com to get started. What's good about trading perpetual futures on Binance wallet web? First up, trading perpetual futures means you can open leverage positions WITHOUT worrying about contract expiry dates, giving you the flexibility to hold your trades as long as you want and you do all this directly from your keyless wallet which means you stay in full control of your assets with no middlemen and zero hassle plus when you trade using the binance keyless wallet benefit from stronger security it's designed to be safer than conventional seed phrase wallets be the multi- computation MBC technology, which prevents single points of failure, helping you keep your assets well protected throughout your trading journey. You can use a wide range of popular BSC tokens, like BNB, Aster, USDT, Bitcoin, ETH and more, as collateral for opening positions. But here's the exciting part. Alongside crypto perpetuals, you also get access to stock perpetuals for top stocks like Apple and Nvidia, plus major ETFs. You can also trade precious metals, stock perpetuals, that track the price of metals, such as XAU, gold, XAG, silver, XPT, platinum, XCU, Copper, and xPD . Please note, these are derivative contracts that reflect metal prices and you are not buying the physical metals themselves. This opens up a whole new world of asset classes right at your fingertips, and as a bonus, every trade you make earns you ASTAs, which unlock exclusive rewards and perks according to Astar's point rules. All of this happens on a platform that's fast, secure and backed by deep liquidity and low fees. So whether you're trading crypto or stocks, you get a seamless powerful experience right in your wallet. How do you find the Binance Wallet on the web? First, log into the Binance Wallet website at web3.binance.com and look for the perpetuals tab. Next, click enable account to get going, then hit approved trading. At this point, open your Binance app on your mobile device you'll need to follow a few quick prompts to confirm and sign off on permissions securely once that's done go to the account page click transfer pick which token and how much you want to use as collateral and confirm the transfer it's all on chain and super transparent after your balance updates you're ready to trade. Open or close future positions, whenever you like, with the full power and control of your self custodial keyless wallet. And remember, every trade you make earns you ASTA points to unlock exclusive rewards. Binance Wallet and ASTA also run special campaigns just for Binance keyless wallet users. So keep an eye out for those. Thats it! Seamless, secure, perpetual futures trading right inside your Binance Wallet web. Remember, safe trading and asset management start with smart security practices. Thanks for watching and happy trading. Binance Keyless Wallets
